text_block_list.text:
With her debut not long behind her, we
joined
some much-needed scrimmages
to bolster her
ability to compete in large
groups, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Gasp... Pant... Third place?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Damn!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
In one scrimmage she'll take first, then
take sixth
in the next. And then first
again. Her results
refuse to stabilize.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
(She's just going to get stressed out at this
rate...)

text_block_list.text:
But through these scrimmages, I've come
to
identify her problem...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Graaaah!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: ...Hyah!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
When challenged by another runner, she
focuses
her energy on the challenger
until they back
down, for the entire race
if need be.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so, when she races against multiple

opponents...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Haaa!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: Think you can pass me?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...Нарита Брайан is unable to run at her
natural pace.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Tch!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Hey, you!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You're Brian's trainer, right? Is she sick
or
something lately?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: She hasn't been herself since her debut!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Where's that insane strength I saw
during our
one-on-one?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Gulp! W-Well yeah, I can't argue with that considering I absolutely got wrecked...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Urk... Come on! Don't make me
remember that!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hurry up and get Brian back on her feet!
I only
beat people down when they're at
their peak.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
The longer I have to hold back now, the
more I'm
gonna let loose when we race!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: What is it, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Tch... Duh. You think there's a racer out
there
that wants to lose?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: In that case, why don't we change our strategy?

text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...In short, if someone passes me in the
middle of
the race, I should just let
them?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
You're telling me to just run away with
my tail
between my legs when there's a
challenge right in
front of me?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: No, that's not what I mean!

text_block_list.text: ...Okay, then what do you mean?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list:
It's not running away or holding back—it's
saving your energy for later.

text_block_list.text: ...Saving energy?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
All of her problems stem from her fierce

competitive spirit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Given that, if she can build that spirit
up, convert
it into energy, and release it
one huge burst...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: You can run in a way that's special to you.

text_block_list.text: Special... to me?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list:
The first across the finish line is the winner,
after all.

text_block_list.text:
...You have to be more detailed than
that.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
At the next scrimmage, seven new racers
come to
participate.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Since Brian's doing so poorly lately, I
feel like I
can actually win!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Me too! I'm definitely not gonna lose!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: "Store up and then explode," right?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: What about the timing?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: I'll leave that up to you.

text_block_list.text:
Just like when racing one-on-one, her

competitive instincts are excellent when
she's in
full control of herself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hmph...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
With nothing more than that to say, she
makes
her way to the gate. And then...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ka-thunk!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: First place is mine!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Like I'll just hand it over! Hehe, see ya!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
As soon as the gate opens, the two
racers fight
vigorously for first place. As
for Нарита Брайан...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, pardon me. Do you mind if I sit next
to you
and watch?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
What's this? She looks much more
relaxed than
before. Found a new
solution, did we?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The competition is pretty fierce at the
front.
Нарита Брайан must be up there too.
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer

text_block_list.text:
Huh? She's not?! She's hanging back in
the middle
still!
text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer

text_block_list.text:
Oh? It's quite rare for her to stay out of
the
action intentionally.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
(Gah... So frustrating... I just want to run
to the
front!)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: (This is actually killing me... My prey is right there, mine for the taking, and I can't chase them down!)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
(That's it, I can't take it anymore—I need
to hunt!)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Haha... I get it now.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...So this is saving energy? You're really
asking a
lot of me, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Oh, they're almost to the fourth turn.
And the
lead... hasn't changed?
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer

text_block_list.text:
She wasn't making progress before, but I
think
this settles it—Brian really is in a
slump.
text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer

text_block_list.text:
That can't be right... This doesn't align
with my
calculations. Has she lost her
passion? Or, don't
tell me...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан has been biding time,
waiting for her
perfect moment to
attack!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And then, as they come out of the fourth
turn...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
(Time to go in for the kill—break
through these
restraints and seize victory
by the throat.)
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...At last, the moment I've been waiting
for.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Huh? What was that just now?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: RAAAHHH!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Gyah!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А and B

text_block_list.text:
Wh-what the?! Нарита Брайан is barreling
to the
front!
text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer

text_block_list.text:
She's fast! How can she be so fast?! She
couldn't
pass anyone before!
text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer

text_block_list.text: How fierce! So this is how she races now!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
No... the word "race" is hardly fitting.
This is more
like... a hunt!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан shoots forth like a bird of
prey
hurtling toward its target.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With no concern for her entranced
audience, she
blasts across the finish
line!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Puff...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Pfff, hahaha!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? I've never
felt like
this before.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
What were you thinking teaching me
this? This
feeling could become an
addiction!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан shows no signs of her usual
fatigue at
the race. In fact, she is
positively glowing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I do believe we've taken one further
step into the
future.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
